defects.what: CG walk characters do not match the painted film: Anpu thin black legs, short fork-heavy sceptre, no readable ankh. Ankhu a generic shirtless CG body. They read as stickers on painted sets.
Extreme close-up with attendants cropped and Anpu hidden behind an attendant, sceptre only an edge stripe, so the key character and prop are unreadable after the cut.
Cast tiny against the set, overlapping and bunching (Ankhu occluded by attendants, Anpu hidden at the gate), stiff gait, sceptre foot looks like a dragging hook (041).

evidence.cinematography: Cuts at 021/025/030/037/040 read and the cam6 gate vista is strong, but 024-025 are extreme close-ups and 033-038 wides make the cast tiny. Letterbox then fade then interior 048 is abrupt.
evidence.grounding: Shadows sit on the paving in 039-041, but the cast bunches in 033-036 and 042-045 with Ankhu occluded by attendants.
